'''Nikola Jović''' ({{lang-sr-Cyrl|Никола Јовић}}; born 9 June 2003) is a Serbian professional [[basketball]] player for [[KK Mega Basket|Mega Mozzart]] of the [[ABA League]]. Standing at {{height|ft=6|in=11}} and weighing {{convert|223|lbs|kg|0}},<ref>{{cite web |title=2022 NBA Draft Profile - Nikola Jovic |url=https://www.nba.com/draft/2022/prospects/nikola-jovic |website=nba.com |access-date=14 June 2022}}</ref> he plays both [[shooting guard]] and [[small forward]] positions.

==Early career==
Jović was born in the [[Leicester Royal Infirmary|Royal Infirmary]] in [[Leicester]], [[Leicestershire]], England as his father Ilija was playing basketball.<ref>{{cite web |title=Tek drugi Srbin u top 10 na draftu? Nikola Jović je Megin novi NBA projekat |url=https://mozzartsport.com/kosarka/vesti/tek-drugi-srbin-u-top-10-na-draftu-nikola-jovic-je-megin-novi-nba-projekat-video/399594 |website=mozzartsport.com |access-date=27 September 2021}}</ref> He grew up playing [[water polo]] for [[VK Partizan]] as well as basketball.<ref name="espn">{{cite web |title=Nikola Jovic: The next great Serbian prospect? |url=https://www.espn.com.au/nba/insider/story/_/id/31352746/nba-draft-why-victor-wembanyama-world-most-intriguing-long-term-prospect#Jovic |website=espn.com.au |access-date=30 April 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=ONI DOLAZE NIKOLA JOVIĆ: Novi srpski zlatni grumen rođen u Engleskoj |url=https://www.novosti.rs/sport/kosarka/1020232/oni-dolaze-nikola-jovic-novi-srpski-zlatni-grumen-rodjen-engleskoj |website=novosti.rs |access-date=26 July 2021}}</ref> Jović was playing basketball for the KK Sava [[youth system]] before he joined the [[KK Mega Basket|Mega Basket]] youth system in 2018.<ref>{{cite web |title=Nikola Jović kao novi Danilović |url=https://www.danas.rs/sport/nikola-jovic-kao-novi-danilovic/ |website=danas.rs |access-date=30 April 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Nikola Jović 0 Bek/Nisko krilo |url=https://www.bcmegabasket.net/player/nikola-jovic/ |website=bcmegabasket.net |access-date=30 April 2021}}</ref> At the [[2020–21 Euroleague Basketball Next Generation Tournament]] in Belgrade, he averaged 29.3 points, 10.3 rebounds, 4.5 assists and 1.8 blocks in 28 minutes per game, while shooting 66% from the [[Field goal (basketball)|field]] and 17% from [[Three-point field goal|three]] and won the MVP award.<ref name="espn"/>

==Professional career==
Jović made his senior debut for [[KK Mega Basket|Mega Basket]] in February 2021 at the [[2020–21 Radivoj Korać Cup|Radivoj Korać Cup]] tournament in [[Novi Sad]]. On 19 March, Jović made his [[ABA League]] debut in a 74–65 loss to [[KK Split|Split]] recording 10 points and 9 rebounds in 21 minutes of playing time.<ref>{{cite web |title=Split 74:65 Mega Soccerbet Beograd |url=https://www.aba-liga.com/match/153/20/1/Boxscore/q1/1/home/split-mega-soccerbet/ |website=aba-liga.com |access-date=30 April 2021}}</ref> On 10 June 2021, one day after his 18th birthday he signed his first professional contract with Mega.<ref>{{cite web |title=Nikola Jović potpisao profesionalni ugovor sa Megom |url=https://www.mozzartsport.com/kosarka/vesti/nikola-jovic-potpisao-profesionalni-ugovor-sa-megom/389727 |website=mozzartsport.com |access-date=10 June 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Prvi profesionalni ugovor – Nikola Jović |url=https://lige.kss.rs/2021/06/11/prvi-profesionalni-ugovor-nikola-jovic/ |website=lige.kss.rs |access-date=18 June 2021}}</ref>

In the [[NBA.com]] [[General manager (basketball)|GM]] Survey for the [[2021–22 NBA season]], Jović received votes for the best international player not playing in the NBA.<ref>{{cite web |title=NBA.com 2021-22 GM Survey |url=https://www.nba.com/news/2021-22-gmsurvey |website=nba.com |access-date=7 October 2021}}</ref> In April 2022, Jović declared for the [[2022 NBA draft]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Nikola Jović izlazi na NBA draft |url=https://www.b92.net/sport/nba/vesti.php?yyyy=2022&mm=04&dd=11&nav_id=2138077 |website=b92.net |access-date=12 April 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Nikola Jovic, 18-year-old top prospect from Serbia, to enter 2022 NBA draft |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/33718313/nikola-jovic-18-year-old-top-prospect-serbia-enter-2022-nba-draft |website=espn.com |access-date=12 April 2022}}</ref> In April 2022, he was named the [[ABA League Top Prospect]] for the [[2021–22 ABA League First Division|2021–22 season]].<ref>{{cite web |title=2021/22 Top Prospect: Nikola Jović (Mega Mozzart) |url=https://www.aba-liga.com/news/46938/2021-22-top-prospect-nikola-jovic-(mega-mozzart)/ |website=aba-liga.com |access-date=26 April 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Nikola Jović najbolji mladi igrač ABA lige |url=https://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2022&mm=04&dd=26&nav_id=2145763 |website=b92.net |access-date=26 April 2022}}</ref> Jović accepted to attend the "green room" for the 2022 NBA draft.<ref>{{cite web |title=KOŠARKAŠKA SRBIJA NEĆE SPAVATI: Sjajna vest pred NBA draft |url=https://www.novosti.rs/sport/kosarka/1128767/nba-draft-2022-nikola-jovic-zelena-soba-green-room-espn-pik-prva-runda-najava-kosarka-srbija-najnovije-vesti |website=novosti.rs |access-date=22 June 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Nikola Jović pozvan u "zelenu sobu" |url=https://www.b92.net/sport/nba/vesti.php?yyyy=2022&mm=06&dd=22&nav_id=2174555 |website=b92.net |access-date=22 June 2022}}</ref>

==National team career==
Jović missed the [[2019 FIBA U16 European Championship]] in [[Udine]], Italy due to a [[right arm]] injury.<ref name="espn"/>

Jović was a member of the [[Serbia men's national under-19 basketball team|Serbia U19 national team]] at the [[2021 FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup]]. Over seven tournament games, he averaged 18.1 points, 8.3 rebounds, and 2.9 assists per game.<ref>{{cite web |title=Nikola JOVIC, PF, 2021 World Cup |url=http://www.fiba.basketball/world/u19/2021/player/Nikola-Jovic |website=fiba.basketball |access-date=13 July 2021}}</ref> He was named to the [[FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup All-Tournament Team|all-tournament team]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.fiba.basketball/world/u19/2021/news/chet-holmgren-takes-home-tissot-mvp-award-after-helping-usa-to-u19-world-cup-title|title=Chet Holmgren takes home TISSOT MVP award after helping USA to U19 World Cup title|publisher=[[FIBA]]|date=11 July 2021|access-date=11 July 2021}}</ref>

In February 2022, Jović made his debut for the [[Serbia men's national basketball team|Serbia national team]] at the [[2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup qualification (Europe)#Qualifiers|2023 FIBA World Cup Qualifiers]], at the age of 18.
